Metadata.title: Nomena R. | Backend & DevOps Developer
Metadata.description: Backend & DevOps developer from Madagascar, 6 years of experience. Specialized in Symfony, PHP, Kubernetes, Docker and CI/CD. I build robust APIs and reliable cloud infrastructure.

projects.eazylangMarketplaceDesc:
Contributor and website maintainer for Eazylang Marketplace.
Eazylang marketplace is a platform that brings together translation professionals and their customers.
projects.eazylangWorkplaceDesc:
Architect, developer and DevOps on Eazylang Workplace: designed the web services and migrated the infrastructure to Kubernetes (Amazon EKS) with CI/CD pipelines in place.
Eazylang Workplace enables translation professionals to set up their own translation agency.
projects.evisaMadagascarDesc: Contributor and maintainer of the official electronic visa issuer website for Madagascar.
projects.dilypseDesc: I contributed as a back-end developer on the Dilypse project, an all-in-one local marketing SaaS platform providing centralized listing management (50+ directories), AI-powered review collection and response, SMS/Email/NFC campaigns, social media posts, instant micro-site, real-time analytics, built on a fault-tolerant architecture orchestrated with Temporal for reliable asynchronous workflow processing.
